speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV) is unlikely given the continuous nature of the spinning; the symptoms suggest vestibular neuritis or labyrinthitis, though the garlic intake might be a distractor or unrelated.
